business_problem: Traditional recommendation systems were not enough to address the nuance of how viewers describe what they want to watch. JioStar needed fast, reliable, cost-conscious discovery for entertainment, live-sports moments, and detailed cricket statistics at very large audience scale and across multiple languages.
solution_summary: JioStar built a conversational video and cricket-stat discovery assistant into JioHotstar using the OpenAI API. Viewers can speak or type requests about movies, shows, live-match moments, or cricket statistics, and receive results through a visual, conversational experience. The team framed production design as a balance of accuracy, latency, and cost, and put answer-scope guardrails in place. Its evaluation approach used a seed dataset expanded with model-generated variations and a maker-checker pattern: one model helped determine an answer while another LLM acted as validator, with domain experts shaping sports-statistics tests. Codex helped generate evaluation cases and update the system. The source does not describe the content-data ingestion, storage, or underlying serving infrastructure beyond the OpenAI API and JioHotstar interface.
